project.title: Native HTTP own-session management and React account menu
project.goal: Expose native own-session list/revoke with ID targets and truthful commit-aware account UI
project.scope: Synthetic native HTTP/React account qualification; no live legacy routing, production writer grant or full identity parity

action.http_sessions.description: Native HTTP list and revoke own sessions

native_cookie_empty_list_or_revoke_objec.description: GET has no body. POST one requires sessionId only; others/all require empty body or object. Cookie is authenticated context, never a target bearer.

output.description: Operation-specific wire result: list success is a direct array of allowlisted SessionSummary objects; revoke success is {status:true}; refusals are fixed error objects. No wrapper list object; CONTRACT.md specifies exact allowlist and headers.

errors.refused: Strict request refusal;401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS or503 AUTH_UNCONFIRMED, without data/cookie success

preconditions: Trusted configured origin/profile and native handler with retained admitted control/lifetime
Exclusive routing and old legacy writer drain before real enablement
postconditions: List only owned active allowlisted metadata, never bearer or partial result
Only known committed revocation returns status:true; only all/current-one clears configured cookies
HEAD and malformed inputs never dispatch; foreign/missing targets remain indistinguishable
React native ID or existing legacy token contracts stay explicit; ambiguous rows refuse; empty/false/null/error/transport ACK never claims success; retry0
external_effects: Native audited session transaction and lifecycle-triggered deletions
Bounded process rate/capacity and HTTP response/cookies
React confirmation and explicit shell/list changes only after true ACK

authorization.rationale: Session ownership, strict wire boundaries and unknown commit must survive HTTP and UI without bearer leakage or false confirmed deletion
